Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]]. It is the fourteenth and final book in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series, and it was first published by [[Berkley Boulevard]] in [[August]] [[1998]]. It also includes a sixteen-page preview of [[Lucasfilm]]'s ''Alien Chronicles: The Crimson Claw''. The novel was reprinted in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Under Black Sun]]'' ([[1999]]).
